title: A 13-Year-Old Beat Tetris by Crashing It at Level 157

scenes.text: A 13-year-old just beat Tetris. By breaking it.
On December 21, 2023, Willis Gibson reached level 157 on a livestream.
Level 29 was long thought to be the limit for players.
The record before him was level 148.
Then the game crashed. It was a glitch nobody had ever documented, the true kill screen.
A kid. Level 157. And the game finally gave up.

description:
A 13-year-old became the first person to beat Tetris, by crashing it.
Willis Gibson reached level 157 on December 21, 2023, and triggered a never-before-documented glitch that stopped the game. The previous record was level 148.
Could you survive past level 29? Comment below.
first_comment: Level 29 was thought to be the limit for decades. What's the furthest you've ever gotten in Tetris?
